svg.title: Divisor smoothness: factorization and support
svg.desc: An imaginary hyperelliptic model makes the infinity convention and the degree of a reduced divisor explicit.
svg.text: An imaginary hyperelliptic model makes the infinity convention and the degree of a reduced divisor explicit.
Use the unique point ∞ as base point; the divisor class group is J=Pic⁰(C).

Heuristic: uniform ambient classes, fixed g and distinct support. Restricted elliptic subfamilies need separate relation statistics.
